observations: Photo 0: A silver portable speaker with a handle on top, front grille, and control buttons. The screen is lit, showing 'Bending My Way (Live)' and 'Neon Radio'.
Photo 1: Same speaker from a slightly different angle, screen still lit, showing the same song and time. The speaker appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.

Photo 2: Close-up of the back label showing 'MONDO BT SPEAKER LARGE', 'Input: 5V 3A 9V 3A', 'Capacity: 6000mAh/66.8Wh', 'FCC ID: 2AKFED200', 'Designed by Defunc', 'Manufactured in China', 'Hollister, Sweden', '113 09 000000'.
Photo 3: Side view of the speaker, showing the handle, screen, and control buttons. The screen is active, displaying the same song and time as in photo 1.
All photos show the speaker on a wooden surface, with a watermark 'DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED'.

claims.evidence: Subjective claim; no objective proof of power or performance in photos. The label mentions 66.8Wh capacity, which is high for a portable speaker, but cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: you can check the label on advert for details
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows the label clearly, confirming the model and specifications.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Speaker may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: A video clip showing the speaker turning on, playing music, and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or not holding charge as claimed (66.8Wh capacity)
risks.proof: A video showing the speaker playing for 10 minutes with the battery indicator remaining lit, or a charge cycle test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery not holding charge

risks.risk: The speaker may be a counterfeit or rebranded product
risks.proof: A close-up of the serial number and a comparison with official Mondo product images or a video of the speaker being powered on with the official Mondo logo visible.

proof_requests: Video of the speaker turning on, playing music, and responding to button presses.
Video showing the speaker playing for 10 minutes with the battery indicator remaining lit.
Close-up of the serial number and a comparison with official Mondo product images.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
